versions.subject: Merge PR #4906 from @fornotes - Update and add new dll sideloading rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\MpSvc.dll'
filter_main_generic:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\'
        - 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Platform\'
        - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\MpSvc.dll" NOT (ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\*", "C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\*", "C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*"))
